label: sound
instruction_covers: data= and config= accept Mapping (not only dict), path, PathLike, and readable text/binary streams, with a mutable snapshot
save_data and save_config accept paths, PathLike, and writable text/binary streams; caller streams stay open
Path success message is the absolute path in the existing status dict; stream success is {"status": true, "message": "Everything seems good."}
Stream write failure is a false-status result whose message includes the underlying error
Snapshots keep both point arrays or both function expressions plus seed/start/step/stop (including zeros) and color, bgcolor, spot_size, size, projection, alpha, linewidth, depth
JSON size is an array; loaded size is the library tuple
samilaConfigError is importable from samila; malformed JSON, read failures, and non-object JSON raise samilaDataError or samilaConfigError with __cause__
Missing plot/generate sections and a config with only f1 or only f2 keep existing defaults and still generate the missing function
notes: samilaConfigError already exists in samila/errors.py next to samilaDataError but is not re-exported in samila/__init__.py; the instruction names the export. function1_str/function2_str, DEFAULT_* in samila.params, Projection.POLAR == 'polar', and DATA_SAVE_SUCCESS_MESSAGE == 'Everything seems good.' are repo-given (R1). Legacy default tests compare against those constants. Partial-config seed is None because load_config only sets seed from a generate section and the initializer leaves it unset. Size is not in the current save/load plot dicts; the instruction explicitly requires the array/tuple round trip.
